Header: Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. punicae Telya Rog

Prevention: Plant orchard with disease free planting material.
Remove fallen leaves and debris from the orchard and burn.
Proper spacing of 5x5m to avoid the disease and pest incidence.
Pruning is done after harvest is completed during
Monitoring: Observe dark brown to brown black necrotic spots, surrounded by a yellow hallow or water soaked margin on leaves and fruit.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Monitor crop regularly and remove affected plant debris from the field
Spraying of garlic extract 5% at 7 day intervals after initiation of the new leaves has been found to be effective
Direct Control (Chemical): Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators.
Bordeaux mixture (0.5% except 1% just after pruning, rest period)
Restrictions: Alternate with spray of streptocycline (5g/10 litre) or 2-bromo, 2-nitro propane-1, 3-diol (5g/10 l) mixed with copper oxychloride or copper hydroxide (20-25g/ 10 litre) and spreader sticker (0.5ml/litre) at 10-15 days interval depending on weather conditions.
The spray interval of 7 days should be adopted in mrig bahar and 10-14 days in hasta and ambe bahar season.
